title: Locus and presence give a path toward the hard problem

statements.text: Taken with earlier work on differences within and between modalities, the analysis of locus and presence suggests a path toward a scientific theory of why experiences feel like something rather than nothing. O’Regan calls the analysis tentative and open to debate.

sources.quote: this article suggests a path toward a scientific theory of the “hard problem” of phenomenal consciousness
Note that the analysis presented in the next sections should be considered tentative and open to debate.
